known_pitfalls: Always use 'tr-TR' locale for case transformations (I/ı, İ/i).
Keep touch targets at least 44x44px for accessibility.
Web audio requires SpeechSynthesis fallback if native Speech is unavailable or in SSR.
build_quirks: Expo Router requires entry in package.json to be 'expo-router/entry'.
Ensure react-native-safe-area-context and react-native-screens are installed.
